name: Kestrel Se'val
source:
Race: Were-cat (Serval)

Practical and observant, Kestrel co-runs Ember & Sands. She has a bad habit of taking responsibility for everyone around her. She tries to solve every problem herself, especially when the people she loves are hurting.
